description: Works without Etsy's API. Checks up to 6 shop names against Etsy's shop name rules (4-20 characters, no spaces or special characters), suggests Etsy's form for a name with spaces, quotes Etsy's naming rules, and gives an etsy.com/shop/<name> link the seller can open themselves. It cannot say whether a name is taken, and a missing shop never means a name is free: Etsy does not reuse names of closed shops.

names.description: Up to 6 names, as an array or a comma-separated string

name: etsy_shop_name_rules
title: Etsy shop name rules
